literal: Emperor Cheng, Xianhe sixth year, first month, day bingchen, moon entered Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: Under Emperor Cheng, in the sixth year of Xianhe, on bingchen in the first month, the moon passed into the Southern Dipper asterism.

literal: The prognostication said: "There will be troops.
idiomatic: The omen text read: armed conflict would follow.

literal: " That month, Shi Le killed and plundered the people of Lou and Wujin, two counties.
idiomatic: That same month Shi Le massacred and looted the populations of Lou and Wujin counties.

literal: The next year, Shi Le's host again raided and plundered Nansha and Haiyu.
idiomatic: The year after, his army again swept through Nansha and Haiyu.

literal: In that eleventh month, Mars guarded Stomach and Mao.
idiomatic: That November Mars stationed between the Stomach and Hairy Head lunar lodges.

literal: The prognostication said: Zhao and Wei have troops.
idiomatic: The interpretation warned of war in the Zhao and Wei heartlands.

literal: " The eighth year, seventh month, Shi Le died; Shi Jilong set himself up.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year Shi Le died and Shi Hu (Jilong) seized supreme authority.

literal: At this time, although the two Shi usurped titles, yet their strength and weakness were always prognosticated in Mao, not involving Supreme Subtlety and Purple Palace.
idiomatic: Even while both Shis bore illegitimate royal styles, their waxing and waning were read chiefly from Hairy Head, not from the sovereign asterisms Taiwei and Ziwei.

literal: Eighth year, third month, day jisi, moon entered Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year, on jisi, the moon entered Southern Dipper.

literal: Same as the sixth year prognostication.
idiomatic: The reading matched the sixth-year omen for the same phenomenon.

literal: That year seventh month, Shi Le died; Peng Biao with Qiao, Shi Sheng with Chang'an, Guo Quan with Qinzhou, together submitted.
idiomatic: That July, upon Shi Le's death, Peng Biao at Qiao, Shi Sheng at Chang'an, and Guo Quan in Qinzhou all came over to Jin.

literal: Thereupon dispatched Supervising Protector Qiu Qiu leading the host to rescue Biao; Biao was defeated; Qiu retreated.
idiomatic: Jin then sent Supervising Protector Qiu Qiu to relieve Peng Biao; Biao was routed and Qiu pulled back.

literal: Again, Shi Jilong, Shi Bin attacked and extinguished Sheng, Quan.
idiomatic: Shi Hu and Shi Bin then campaigned against and destroyed Shi Sheng and Guo Quan.

literal: That seventh month, Mars entered Mao.
idiomatic: In that same seventh month Mars entered the Hairy Head lodge.

literal: The prognostication said: "The Hu king will die.
idiomatic: The omen declared the death of a northern barbarian ruler.

literal: " One saying: "The Zhao region has troops.
idiomatic: An alternate gloss predicted fighting in the Zhao territories.

literal: " That month, Shi Le died; Shi Jilong many places attacked and wiped out.
idiomatic: That month Shi Le died, and Shi Hu launched widespread offensives that overran numerous districts.

literal: Eighth month, moon again transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: In the eighth month the moon again occulted or brushed Hairy Head.

literal: The prognostication said: "The Hu will not be at peace.
idiomatic: The reading warned of unrest among the northern regimes.

literal: " Ninth year, third month, day jihai, Mars entered Chariot Ghost, transgressed Accumulated Corpses.
idiomatic: On jihai in the third month of the ninth year Mars entered Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses cluster.

literal: The prognostication said: "Troops in the northwest; there is drowning of armies and death of generals.
idiomatic: The gloss foretold northwestern campaigns with drowned hosts and fallen commanders.

literal: " Sixth month, eighth month, moon again transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: The moon repeated its encroachment on Hairy Head in the sixth and again in the eighth month.

literal: At this time, although Shi Hong inherited Le's position, yet Shi Jilong monopolized might and was violent; eleventh month deposed Hong and set himself up; thereupon imprisoned and killed him.
idiomatic: Shi Hong had succeeded Shi Le in name, but Shi Hu wielded real power with brutal force; in the eleventh month he deposed Hong, proclaimed himself ruler, then had him confined and murdered.

literal: Xiankang first year, second month, day jihai, Great White transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: In the first year of Xiankang, on jihai in the second month, Venus crossed Hairy Head.

literal: The prognostication said: "Troops arise; mid-year drought.
idiomatic: The omen paired war with a midsummer drought.

literal: " Fourth month, Shi Jilong raiding cavalry reached Liyang; added Minister of Education Wang Dao as Grand Marshal; regulated troops, arrayed garrisons at choke points.
idiomatic: In the fourth month Shi Hu's raiding horsemen pushed to Liyang; Wang Dao was promoted to grand marshal and troops were mobilized to hold the strategic defiles.

literal: At this time, Shi Jilong again besieged Xiangyang.
idiomatic: About the same time Shi Hu renewed his siege of Xiangyang.

literal: Sixth month, drought.
idiomatic: A severe drought struck in the sixth month.

literal: That year third month, day bingxu, moon entered Mao.
idiomatic: On bingxu in the third month of that year the moon entered Hairy Head.

literal: The prognostication said: "The Hu king will die.
idiomatic: The same death-of-barbarian-king gloss was recorded again.

literal: " Eighth month, day wuxu, Mars entered Eastern Well.
idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month Mars entered the Eastern Well asterism.

literal: The prognostication said: "If no troops, troops arise;
idiomatic: One branch of the omen read: peace breeds mobilization;

literal: if there are troops, troops cease.
idiomatic: where armies are already in the field, they will instead stand down.

literal: " Eleventh month, moon transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month the moon again trespassed on Hairy Head.

literal: Second year, first month, day xinhai, moon transgressed the second star south of Room.
idiomatic: On xinhai in the first month of the second year the moon crossed the southern second star of the Room lodge.

literal: Eighth month, moon again transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: The eighth month saw another lunar approach to Hairy Head.

literal: Ninth month, day gengyin, Great White transgressed Southern Dipper, therefore was seen by day.
idiomatic: On gengyin in the ninth month Venus crossed Southern Dipper and appeared in daylight.

literal: The prognostication said: "Dipper is the chancellor; also Yangzhou's division; metal transgresses it, image of death and mourning.
idiomatic: The gloss identified the Dipper with chief ministers and the Yangzhou celestial field; Venus intruding there betokened mortality and lamentation.

literal: Being seen by day means not minister; also means troops and mourning.
idiomatic: Daytime visibility implied disloyal ministers and further augured war and bereavement.

literal: " After this, Shi Jilong usurped the title Heavenly King, raised the host seventy thousand;
idiomatic: Thereafter Shi Hu arrogated the style Heavenly King and marched seventy thousand men.

literal: Fourth year, second month, from Longxi attacked and killed Duan Liao at Ji, also raided Murong Huang at Jicheng, did not overcome; Huang struck and defeated his general Ma Qiu, and captured Duan Liao and killed him.
idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year he struck from Longxi, slew Duan Liao at Ji, then struck Murong Huang at Jicheng but failed; Huang routed his general Ma Qiu, took Duan Liao captive, and executed him.

literal: Third year, seventh month, day jiyou, moon transgressed the upper star of Room.
idiomatic: On jiyou in the seventh month of the third year the moon crossed the upper star of Room.

literal: Eighth month, Mars entered Chariot Ghost, transgressed Accumulated Corpses.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Mars entered Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses.

literal: Day jiaxu, moon transgressed Eastern Well's distance star.
idiomatic: On jiaxu the moon impinged on the separator star of Eastern Well.

literal: Ninth month, day wuzi, moon transgressed Establishment stars.
idiomatic: On wuzi in the ninth month the moon crossed the Establishment asterism.

literal: Fourth year, fourth month, day jisi, Great White seen by day, in Willow.
idiomatic: On jisi in the fourth month of the fourth year Venus shone in daylight within the Willow lodge.

literal: The prognostication said: "Means troops; means not minister.
idiomatic: The reading cited war and treasonous ministers.

literal: " Next year, Shi Jilong greatly raided south of the Mian; thereupon inner and outer martial alert.
idiomatic: The following year Shi Hu launched a major incursion south of the Han River, and the court declared full civil and military mobilization.

literal: That fifth month, day wuxu, Mars transgressed Right Law Enforcer.
idiomatic: On wuxu in that fifth month Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer star in Taiwei.

literal: The prognostication said: "Great ministers die; those who hold power worry.
idiomatic: The gloss foretold the death of senior ministers and anxiety for the men at the helm of government.
